layout.arrangement: Title centered at top inside a thin red-bordered frame; slide number '51' in a yellow circle at top-right corner. Below the title, two side-by-side panels: left panel is a scatter diagram with axes and caption 'Select Nearest 20 Neighbors' underneath; right panel is a dot/lollipop plot with axes, caption 'Vote on 20 Nearest Neighbors' underneath, and a small legend 'K=20, green class' at its top-left. A large diagonal gray watermark 'High Bias (Bad)' spans across the middle of both panels.

regions.name: title bar
regions.content: Title text 'K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) , K=20' with 'K-Nearest Neighbors' in dark red and '(KNN) , K=20' in blue; yellow circle with '51' at far right

regions.name: left diagram panel
regions.content: Scatter of colored circles (green cluster lower-left, blue cluster upper-right, orange cluster bottom-center) with a red query point; thin lines connect the red point to its 20 nearest neighbors which are ringed with magenta dashed circles; red L-shaped axes; caption below

regions.name: right diagram panel
regions.content: Ascending lollipop/dot plot of 20 neighbors ordered by distance: red dots along x-axis baseline, dotted vertical lines rising to colored dots (cyan, green, then orange) with small red arrows; vertical blue cutoff line after the 20th neighbor; legend 'K=20, green class' with 'green' highlighted in green; caption below

regions.name: watermark
regions.position: diagonal across center, bottom-left to top-right
regions.content: Large outlined gray text 'High Bias (Bad)' rotated ~45 degrees

layout.hierarchy: Title dominates in large bold red/blue text; the two diagrams are co-dominant visual content; captions in dark red are secondary; the gray watermark is large but low-contrast; legend and slide number are smallest

visual_elements.description: Left panel: 2D scatter with red L-shaped axes (no tick labels). Three clusters of filled circles with dark outlines: ~8 green circles lower-left, ~9 blue circles upper-right, ~4 orange circles bottom-center, plus one magenta/pink circle near the orange cluster. A single solid red circle (query point) sits center-upper area. Thin gray lines radiate from the red point to 20 selected neighbors; each selected neighbor is highlighted with a magenta dashed ring. A small black arrow/cursor points near the green cluster.

Right panel: lollipop-style ranking plot with red L-shaped axes (no numeric ticks). ~20 red dots along the x-axis baseline; from each, a thin dotted vertical line rises to a colored dot with a tiny red arrow marker. Dots ascend left to right in height (distance order): first ~7 cyan dots, then ~9 green dots, then ~4 orange dots at the far right. A vertical blue line marks the K=20 cutoff just before the last few orange points. Legend at top-left reads 'K=20, green class' with the word 'green' on a bright green highlight.
Yellow circle containing black number '51' (slide number badge)
Diagonal watermark text 'High Bias (Bad)' in large hollow/outlined gray letters rotated about 45 degrees, overlaid across both panels

imagery: No photographs; all graphics are vector-style diagrams of colored circles, lines, and axes
typography_notes: Sans-serif throughout. Title is large and bold, mixed colors (dark red for 'K-Nearest Neighbors', blue for '(KNN) , K=20'). Captions under panels are bold dark red. Legend text is small black with green highlight on the word 'green'. Watermark is very large hollow gray lettering. No bullet points or numbered lists.
animation_state: Appears fully built; no partially revealed elements. The watermark 'High Bias (Bad)' suggests this frame is the annotated/conclusion state of the slide.
recreation_brief: 1. White background slide with a thin dark-red rectangular border inset slightly from edges. 2. Top center: bold title 'K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) , K=20' — color 'K-Nearest Neighbors' dark red (#B00000) and '(KNN) , K=20' blue (#0000CC). 3. Top-right: yellow circle (#FFFF99) with black '51'. 4. Left panel (~half width): draw red L-shaped axes; scatter ~8 green circles lower-left, ~9 blue circles upper-right, ~4 orange circles bottom-center, 1 magenta circle near oranges; place one solid red circle center-top; draw thin gray lines from red circle to 20 surrounding points and add magenta dashed rings around those 20 points; add small black arrow near green cluster. 5. Below left panel, bold dark-red caption 'Select Nearest 20 Neighbors'. 6. Right panel: red L-shaped axes; place ~20 red dots along baseline; from each draw a dotted vertical line up to a colored dot with small red arrow, heights increasing left to right; color dots cyan (first ~7), green (next ~9), orange (last ~4); draw a vertical blue cutoff line near the right end. 7. Top-left of right panel: text 'K=20, green class' with 'green' highlighted bright green. 8. Below right panel, bold dark-red caption 'Vote on 20 Nearest Neighbors'. 9. Overlay large rotated (~45°) hollow gray text 'High Bias (Bad)' diagonally across the center as a watermark.
